text_block_list.text: ――Christmas Day.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, step right up, step right uuup! Ya 
all dressed up to the nines or what!? 
Good girls get juice in their right hand, 
and party poppers in their left~!"

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Amazing, it's so lavish...! I'm so glad I 
dressed up~! 
Did you get a popper? I got orange 
juice~!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Alriiiight, is everyone ready~~?? 
Here we go!!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: MERRY CHRISTMAAAS!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"We've got tons of fun games planned! 
Board games, cards, 
cosplay, party prompts, followed by the 
gift exchange!"

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah~~!! The rumors about all the stuff 
they set up were true! 
Hey, which one are you joining? Ahh, what 
should I do~?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —And!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"We shall hold an attraction that combines 
everything into one— 
'Life-Sized Sugoroku.'"

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: L-Life-sized sugoroku~~!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Take a look at the cafeteria entrance! 
See the 'Start Line'? 
From right here, we're gonna blow the roof 
off and use the whole academy for this 
board game!!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"We have prepared a life-sized course 
so that everyone may enjoy themselves to 
their heart's content."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"The rules are simple. You, the 
participants, will serve as the game 
pieces, 
rolling these dice to advance along the 
board—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Starting from this cafeteria, you will 
make your way around the campus, 
pass through the central plaza... and aim 
for the goal at the gymnasium."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Furthermore, each space has 
a specific mission written upon it."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Some spaces even have special games 
prepared, 
so please look forward to them."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"We on the management committee will serve 
as your guides. Please feel free 
to ask us anything during play. And our 
'Game Master' will be—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"None other than We. Indulge yourselves in 
the revelry to your hearts' content."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, everyone, have a wonderful 
time."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone seems to be making steady 
progress, don't they...? 
Now then, you'll be reaching the first 
Special Point soon."

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"One, two, three! 'Special Space here'? 
Um, enter the classroom...?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome to the Special Space— 
Care to play with me?"

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Whoa... W-Where are we...?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Here, you can experience one of six 
random games. 
The rules are simple."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If you players challenge me and win, you 
get a present. 
And if I lose, as a penalty, I'll have to 
chug a cup of bitter kuding tea."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"On the flip side, if you lose... you know 
what happens, right? 
Heh, don't look so terrified. First, roll 
this die to see which game—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"My, my... There seems to be one flaw in 
that explanation. 
What exactly happens if the challengers 
lose...?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Tch, well, the moment they started the 
board game, it was already too late 
anyway. 
...Wanna hear it? The thrilling stakes on 
the line?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll tell ya. 
If you lose this match――――"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "You won't get a present...!!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "............So basically, zero risk?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, you a challenger? First, let's decide 
which game to play with this. 
...Heh, don't be so stiff. Want me to roll 
the die for ya?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Let's take it easy. —A '1', huh? Lucky 
you. 
'Thrilling Judgment of Hell.' A simple 
game for beginners."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"These two juices look completely 
identical. 
One is delicious, but the other is numbing 
sour."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"You and I will each pick one and drink 
it. Naturally, whoever gets the tasty one 
wins. Best of five games, first to three 
wins takes it. Simple, right?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "Now—make your pick."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Game four. If yours is the tasty one, you 
win. 
Ready, set—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"*Gulp*... *Gaaaasp*... S-Soooo... 
soouuur... 
...Impressive, young lady. Take your 
present."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"First time playing poker? Alright, I'll 
teach ya. 
No need to be scared. Beginner's luck is a 
real thing, after all."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Check the guide in your hand for the hand 
rankings. They're listed from strongest to 
weakest. 
After that, well, it's luck. —Aim for 
whatever you like and build your hand."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"――――Incredible. Haha, hahahaha! 
Pulling a 'Straight Flush' right off the 
bat, huh?!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, you win. Go ahead and take your 
present. 
...And now, for my punishment game."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"—*Gulp*, aaarghhh... That really hits 
ya... Super bitter..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"You rolled a '4'... That means your game 
is 'Baccarat.' 
We'll play five games total, and whoever 
ends up with more chips takes the win."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"First up... let's place our bets. 
Go all in with confidence, alright? In 
stuff like this, momentum is everything."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha! What insane luck you've got!! 
Your victory's locked in—...is what I'd 
like to say, but."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Here's a bonus chance. For the final 
game, 
if you bet all your chips and win, I'll 
double your present."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, if you lose, you lose 
everything... but that's exactly why your 
heart's racing, right? 
Come on—let's make it thrilling...!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "Cards... open!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"A total of '9'! Ha—Hahaha! You pull the 
absolute best hand here?! 
Splendid, I surrender! Take your double 
present!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"That was a good time. ――――Let's play 
again sometime."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, who's the next challenger! This 
here is a mandatory stop Special Space! 
Let's have ourselves a white-knuckle 
showdown...!
